triggers.detailsText: The merger is expected tobe completed in the second half of 2027-28 (FY28), with an appointed date of April 1, 2027.Atthe current price, the IHCL stock, which has gained about 11per cent over the past three months, is trading at about 37x itsFY28 earningsestimates. Although OHL’searnings are currently captured in IHCL’s consolidated net proﬁt through associate accounting, the merger will result in full line-by-line consolidation of OHL’soperations, adding ~500 crore of revenue and ~130 crore of earnings before interest, tax, depreciation, and amortisation (Ebitda) to IHCL’sconsolidated ﬁnancials. IHCL ended 2025-26 (FY26) with Ebitda of ~3,477 crore.
